blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO), through its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program, turned over Charitimba food packs and medical devices for residents of the 2nd District of Albay, the 4th District of Quezon Province, and the 5th District of Quezon City on October 1, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. PCSO Executive Assistant VI Atty. Maria Katrina Nicole Contacto-Ventanilla formally turned over the assistance to the authorized representatives of the beneficiary districts: Political Affairs Assistant I Henry Callope Jr. for the 2nd District of Albay; Political Affairs Officer III Atty.
